asset.name: Icon Registry
asset.description: The normalized icon source and geometry registry supporting individual imports, optical sizing, stroke policy, direction-aware flipping, and accessibility metadata for decorative versus meaningful icons.

requires.reason: Optical sizes and stroke weights resolve to token ramps rather than per-icon values.

rationale: A registry rather than direct imports is what makes icon weight consistency checkable at all, and what keeps a broad icon-package import out of the bundle.
